4 Bedroom House in Somerset West Central

18a oatlands
4 3 4 999 m² 300 m²

House For Sale in Martinville, Roundhay, Somerset West

Family Living in Sought-After Roundhay, Somerset West

Sole & Exclusive Mandate. Nestled in a quiet panhandle, this family home offers space, comfort, and convenience in the highly desirable suburb of Roundhay, Somerset West.

This home presents an excellent opportunity for buyers willing to invest in some updating and maintenance.

Boasting 4 generously sized bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, the home offers an ideal layout for families. Three bedrooms are conveniently located on the ground floor, while the fourth bedroom upstairs provides the perfect private retreat for guests, a teenager, or a home office. The spacious main bedroom features a modern en-suite bathroom with a shower.

The heart of the home is the stylish open-plan kitchen and dining area, creating a welcoming space where family and friends naturally gather. Flowing seamlessly from the dining room is a spacious living area complete with a built-in braai, perfect for year-round entertaining. Large sliding doors open onto an established garden, offering plenty of space for children to play, pets to roam, or for creating your own outdoor oasis.

Additional features include:

4 Spacious bedrooms

3 Bathrooms

Main bedroom with en-suite bathroom

Open-plan kitchen and dining room

Large living area with built-in braai

Sliding doors leading to a generous private garden

Double garage

Security Alarm system with CCTV cameras

Automated entrance gate

Secure panhandle position offering added privacy

Perfectly positioned close to some of Somerset Wests most prestigious schools, renowned wine estates, the world-famous Erinvale Golf Estate, shopping centres, restaurants, and with easy access to major routes, this home offers an exceptional lifestyle in one of the areas most sought-after neighbourhoods.

A family home where comfort, privacy and location come together beautifully. Contact me today to arrange your private viewing.
